description: This bar chart illustrates the percentage point difference in morphosyntactic probing performance across different model configurations, with the vertical axis labeled “% point difference” ranging from -0.1 to 0.2 in linear scale and marked with tick intervals of 0.1, and the horizontal axis displaying categorical model configurations including “hidden:[], linear”, “hidden:[100], ReLU”, and “hidden:[50, 50], ReLU”. Each configuration is represented by a pair of stacked bars: a light blue bar and a darker blue bar, indicating two distinct metrics or conditions for each model configuration. The “hidden:[], linear” configuration has a light blue bar extending down to approximately -0.05 and a dark blue bar extending up to approximately 0.05. The “hidden:[100], ReLU” configuration has a light blue bar extending down to approximately -0.07 and a dark blue bar extending up to approximately 0.15. The “hidden:[50, 50], ReLU” configuration has a light blue bar extending down to approximately -0.09 and a dark blue bar extending up to approximately 0.18. The bars are not sorted and appear to be arranged in the order of the horizontal axis labels. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, or outlines beyond their standard presentation.
